note: Webster County GA has no zoning ordinance: its 2010 comprehensive plan self-assessment says the community had no zoning ordinance, and the county is a unified government with no incorporated municipalities (Preston and Weston merged into it in 2009), so no city zoning layer exists either. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for zoning in the county returned no zoning layers; the county website links only to Q-Public parcels, the Municode code of ordinances, and the GIS Clearinghouse.
